description: Fetches one URL and returns the readable page as markdown: title, description, headings, paragraphs and links with their destinations, plus the canonical URL, language and word count. Boilerplate, scripts and navigation are stripped. Built for going through a list of links one at a time. No API key, no account. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

links.description: Also return the outbound links as a list. Defaults to false.

url.description: The page to read. http and https only; private and loopback addresses are refused.

name: web_read
title: Read a web page as markdown
